create_FastplaneModule: create a FastplaneModule with MLP hidden size, render dimension, and number of samples for neural rendering
run_FastplaneModule_forward: run the FastplaneModule forward pass with rays, centers, near/far distances, and triplane or voxel grid inputs
configure_FastplaneModule_shape: configure FastplaneModule with triplane or voxel grid shape representation for 3D scene rendering
set_FastplaneModule_opacity: set FastplaneModule opacity initialization bias and activation function for alpha channel prediction
process_FastplaneModule_bg_color: process FastplaneModule background color from float or tuple into a render-dimension tensor
